# Lavendar Lewis

[Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge)

## Appearance

Lavendar is a little lady with thick, beautifully wavy snow-white hair that is carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils. Beneath her hair is a fresh, almost girlish face featuring pink, pretty cheeks, dimples, and sweet lips. Her big, soft, wood-brown eyes are a pretty shade with little golden glints in them.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)_

## Personality

A self-described proud and dreadfully sulky individual, this character admits that these combined traits can create a difficult temperament. Driven by a deep love for company, they frequently turn to an imaginative nature and a penchant for pretending in order to cope with loneliness.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis, who was named by her father after his favorite scent, lived a quiet life at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her young helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Years after a foolish quarrel severed her past romance with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), she made the acquaintance of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) when they stumbled upon her home. Miss Lavendar quickly bonded with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and was later introduced to Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), with whom she shared a warm connection. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) noticed Miss Lavendar growing listless, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) returned to town and sent word through [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he wished to see her. Following a nervous preparation, Miss Lavendar reunited with Stephen in her garden, leading to their reconciliation, engagement, and a garden wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the newly married couple departed.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +266 more_

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "About your age I think. He ought to be older because I dreamed him long before you were born. But I’ll never let him get any older than eleven or twelve; because if I did some day he might grow up altogether and then I’d lose him."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P61](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0061)

> "I’m wholesomely ashamed to think that a new dress . . . even it is a forget-me-not organdy . . . should exhilarate me so, when a good conscience and an extra contribution to Foreign Missions couldn’t do it."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Miss Lavendar meet when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally stumbles upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) while lost in the woods, becoming very dear friends and kindred spirits. Miss Lavendar confides the painful story of her past romance to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who regularly visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to keep her company. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also acts as a bridge to Miss Lavendar's past by introducing her to [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and later helping relay messages during her reunion with Stephen.

- Friend of — very dear friend and kindred spirit  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the Fourth serves as Miss Lavendar's young handmaiden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Beyond her household duties, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) is deeply protective of Miss Lavendar, worrying about her well-being and enlisting Anne's help whenever her mistress seems lonely or listless. She actively assists Miss Lavendar during major life events, including helping her prepare for Stephen Irving's return and her wedding.

- Commands — employer of little handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

Miss Lavendar first hears of [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) through [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), reacting quietly to the mention of his surname before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings him to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to meet her. The two quickly become particular friends, sharing delightful visits in the garden where [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) enjoys the echoes and engages in imaginative conversations with Miss Lavendar about her ideal dreams. Their bond serves as a comforting prelude to Miss Lavendar reuniting with Paul's father.

- Friend of — particular friends who visit and talk  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)</sub>

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen and Miss Lavendar shared a romance years earlier that ended in a falling-out, leaving her living in quiet seclusion. After Stephen returns to town and sends word through [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), the pair reunite at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and reconcile their past. Their renewed romance culminates in a wedding ceremony held in Miss Lavendar's honeysuckle garden.

- Spouse of — married in a ceremony in the honeysuckle arbor  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>
